description: Use this when the user wants registry ideas or a gift from the Zola shop: kitchen, home, travel, experiences, and more. Searches the Zola registry shop by product type, brand, color, or style, with an optional highest price. Gives up to 6 products, each with its price, its product page on zola.com, and its colors and sizes with their stock. Do not use to find a couple's registry (use zola_find_couple).

max_price.description: The highest price in whole US dollars

query.description: What to find, with the type, brand, color, or style, for example 'cast iron dutch oven'

name: zola_search_registry_products

outputSchema.description: Products of the Zola registry shop

products.description: The matching products of the Zola registry shop

options.description: The colors and sizes of the product, 1 for each SKU, as the shop page lists them. Empty when Zola gives none

in_stock.description: False when Zola cannot sell this option now

label.description: The color and the size as the shop page shows them, for example 'Matte Black' or 'Navy / King'

price_cents.description: The price of this option, in US cents

sku_id.description: The SKU of this color or size

url.description: The product page of this color

price.description: Price or price range in US dollars, for example '$45 to $120'

url.description: The product page in the Zola registry shop

search_url.description: The zola.com shop search, when the products of the search are all above max_price

status.description: no_results when no product of the Zola registry shop matches

title: Search the Zola Registry Shop
